# Test cases the Windows CI job skips on top of realtime-tests.txt, by what the runner lacks. tools/ci-tests.sh reads
# this list on Windows; a new entry needs a reviewer's OK.
# These store a real entry in the Credential Manager, which a session without a user profile's credential store (a CI
# runner, an SSH session) refuses. They run on a Windows machine's desktop session.
*a credential stored in the Credential Manager reads back for its account only*
*the API key comes from the Credential Manager or the environment, never from a file on Windows*
# These record HEVC, which needs a hardware video encoder (NVENC or a Media Foundation hardware encoder; the LGPL FFmpeg
# build has no software HEVC encoder), and the windows-2025 runner has no GPU. They run on a Windows machine with one.
off Apple, frames record to HEVC and decode back to the pictures handed in
off Apple, precise recording hands the encoders 10 bits where they take them
off Apple without NVENC, HEVC records through Media Foundation's encoder
off Apple, past its maximum length a recording goes on in the next numbered file without losing a frame
off Apple, the recording's audio track is AAC at 48 kHz in sync with the frames whatever the input rate
off Apple, a recording never makes its caller wait: a slow writer drops recorded frames
off Apple, a recording cut off by a killed engine still plays up to its last fragment and is recovered
